name: Graphite
sub: Pencil hatching laid in strokes with tapered pressure. Graphite only lands on the tooth peaks the lead touches — and graphite is a metal: burnished, it gleams. Drag the light and the dark strokes turn silver.

in.o: params object — keys below; every length in CSS px
in.dpr: device px per CSS px (density is physical: marks per CSS px²)

x.S: params of every effect keyed by id; the stock this prints on is read from S[printsOn]
x.umask: optional: clips.umask — a typed or image mask (mShape type | image)

out.lin: Float32Array W·H·3, linear-light sRGB (encode with FX.toRGBA(R,"image",W,H))
out.ink: Float32Array W·H, absorbance / coverage (FX.toRGBA(R,"ink",…) = film positive)
out.stock: Float32Array W·H, stock height (FX.toRGBA(R,"stock",…) = normalized height map)

light.note: az = direction the light comes FROM (screen degrees; 0 = right, 90 = below); el = elevation above the sheet

deterministic: yes — every random draw is a hash of (position, seed); same inputs → same pixels in the same engine

params.label: Hatch angle
params.note: direction of the first layer

params.label: Spacing
params.note: distance between strokes

params.label: Layers
params.note: cross-hatch layers; layer k prints only where value > k / layers

params.label: Cross angle
params.note: offset between layers

params.label: Stroke length
params.note: mean stroke length

params.label: Jitter
params.note: spacing and length irregularity

params.label: Wobble
params.note: hand tremor across the stroke

params.label: Pressure
params.note: peak pressure in a stroke

params.label: Taper
params.note: pressure lift at both ends

params.label: Dropoff curve
params.note: value from → to across the field

params.label: Prints on
params.note: paper = FX-03 live, cloth = FX-04 live, smooth = no substrate (film-splitting noise only). Tune the stock and this plate redraws.

params.label: Stock bite
params.note: how much the stock height (vs film-splitting noise) decides where ink lands

params.label: Break-up ↔ thin
params.note: 1 = ink film breaks into marks on the peaks as pressure falls; 0 = the film stays whole and thins to tone

params.label: Starve
params.note: the lowest share of the surface never takes ink — pinholes in the solid, placed by the paper's valleys and pits

params.label: Mottle
params.note: paper formation (its low-frequency cloudiness) varying the film thickness

params.label: Film split
params.note: clump size of the film-splitting noise (the roller's own speckle)

params.label: Graphite · L
params.note: OKLCH lightness (0 black … 1 white)

params.label: Graphite · C

limits.why: most hues leave sRGB above ~.26 and get chroma-reduced

params.note: OKLCH chroma; reduced at constant L/h if it leaves sRGB

params.label: Graphite · h
params.note: OKLCH hue angle

params.label: Deposit
params.note: how opaque a full-pressure pass is

params.label: Sheen
params.note: specular strength of burnished graphite

params.label: Gloss
params.note: specular exponent — tight = burnished, broad = matte

params.label: Burnish texture
params.note: micro-relief of the graphite deposit along the stroke (what catches the glints)

params.label: Shape
params.note: the region the effect may occupy — type = your words as the mask; image = upload a PNG/SVG (alpha, or dark = ink)

params.label: Mask text
params.note: set in Archivo 800, fit to the plate

params.label: Inset
params.note: distance from the plate edge to the mask edge

params.label: Edge wander

limits.why: above ~28 px the edge tears into islands

params.note: how far noise pushes the edge in and out

params.label: Wander scale
params.note: wavelength of the wander; small = ragged, large = drifting

params.label: Roughness
params.note: octaves of edge noise — adds fine teeth without moving the large shape

params.label: Feather
params.note: width over which coverage falls from 1 to 0

params.label: Bite
params.note: clumped dropouts that grow more likely toward the edge

params.label: Seed
params.note: every random draw in the effect hangs off this one number

recipe: Hatch strokes along an angle at a spacing; extra layers cross at an offset angle and only print where the value field asks for more tone.
Each stroke is a wobbling polyline with pressure tapering at both ends, rasterized as AA capsules (lead width).
Ink chain: pressure vs stock-height percentile — the lead touches peaks first; valleys stay white. Graphite is an opaque OKLab mix, not a film.
Sheen: normals from the stock relief plus the graphite deposit's own burnish texture; Blinn specular toward the sheet light, gated by how much graphite is there.
Light last: diffuse × stock shading, + specular.

limits.what: strokes read as wet ink, not graphite
